title: Boundary-contract fallback qualification for prescribed-qbot
question: Can prescribed-qbot use exact authoritative retention/capacity with lookup conductivity as a boundary-contract fallback that restores strict nonlinear-path invariance across the qualified 12-case matrix, and is that hybrid faster than fully analytical hydraulics?
candidate: exact authoritative theta and C plus selected F-AHL15 lookup K
stage_1_gates: identical state, flux, mass and nonlinear-path gates to F-AHL21C; require 12/12

stage_2_timing.protocol: paired O3 timing, 7 repetitions, alternating order, table generation/binding outside timed solve batches

decision_rule: If fidelity closes but timing is not faster, prescribed-qbot should fall back to fully analytical hydraulics rather than retain a lookup solely for K. If fidelity fails, boundary-contract fallback itself is rejected.
